method: Independent analytic derivation with numerical checks, separate from rendered labels
claims: For ellipse focal sum 2a, reflecting the second focus across the supporting line unfolds the focal path into length 2a. Every other point on that line has a strictly longer broken path by triangle inequality, hence lies outside the ellipse. The line is tangent and equal reflection angles send rays to the other focus.
Ideal planar specular reflection; this alone is not a full acoustic or optical wave model.

checks.description: 401 ray reflections agree with the second focus
Other tested mirror points have strictly larger focal sums

limitations: Numerical samples check implementations; general conclusions rest on the stated mathematical arguments.
